corpus.title: Attention Is All You Need
corpus.text: The Transformer replaces recurrence and convolution with self-attention. Multi-head attention projects queries, keys, and values into parallel representation subspaces. Sinusoidal positional encoding supplies token order information. Residual connections and layer normalization surround every encoder and decoder sub-layer.

corpus.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
corpus.text: Retrieval-augmented generation combines a parametric language model with non-parametric external memory. A retriever selects relevant passages and the generator conditions its answer on retrieved evidence. Grounded retrieval improves knowledge-intensive question answering and allows provenance through source passages.

corpus.title: Billion-scale Similarity Search with GPUs
corpus.text: FAISS provides efficient vector similarity search and clustering for dense embeddings. An index supports nearest-neighbor retrieval using distance metrics, compressed representations, and GPU acceleration. Approximate search trades a small amount of recall for lower latency and memory usage.

corpus.title: RAG Evaluation with Retrieval and Groundedness Metrics
corpus.text: Production evaluation separates retrieval quality from answer quality. Retrieval is measured with hit rate, recall at k, and mean reciprocal rank. Generation evaluation measures groundedness, citation completeness, and unsupported claims. Versioned golden datasets and regression thresholds prevent silent quality degradation.

corpus.title: Approximate Indexes for Analytical Databases
corpus.text: Database indexes reduce lookup latency but consume additional memory. Approximate database search can trade recall for faster query speed. The system stores compressed table summaries rather than dense embedding vectors.

corpus.title: Attention in Recurrent Sequence Models
corpus.text: A recurrent encoder processes tokens in order and an attention layer aligns decoder states with encoder states. Unlike fully attention-based architectures, recurrence remains responsible for sequence order.

corpus.title: Metrics for Imbalanced Classification
corpus.text: Classifier evaluation reports precision, recall, F1 score, and area under the precision-recall curve. Threshold selection changes the balance between false positives and false negatives.

corpus.title: Citation and Provenance in Scientific Writing
corpus.text: Scientific citations let readers trace statements to source evidence. Complete references include authors, title, year, and a stable URL. Unsupported statements should be removed or clearly qualified.
